# Logging In & Getting Connected to Levitate

## Logging In to Levitate

You'll receive an email from Levitate App with the subject **Welcome to Levitate!**

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f26fff0ed955013b8755ce/file-jdZ8B95wqh.png)

This is what it'll look like. You'll choose **Set up your account.**

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f26ffe5e6a7b6a1f76d001/file-GL6tFZfKLF.png)

**Step 1:** Enter your First Name, Last Name, and Phone Number.

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f26ffea55fdb408444428f/file-72ltWVQusg.png)

**Step 2:** Create a password

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f26fffece9afe68bb7fadf/file-LK1Vp6WvOr.png)

**Step 3:** Connect Levitate to your email server. This will vary based on the email provider you are using! You will also have the option to choose if you'd like for Levitate to pull in any contacts from your email address book. You can also choose if you'd like those contacts to be Public or Private.

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f270000ed955013b8755cf/file-sqSvwbFtad.png)

Next, you'll choose which email address you'll be connecting to. **At this step, with some email providers, you might have to enter your email address and the password for logging in to access that email address.**

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f26ffe1b49134fe879589b/file-FTLWxdpl5I.png)

And then you'll continue to start the authorization process. **Need more help getting connected? There are finer details below!**

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f27000d7a0d11cccffae02/file-vulqN84yFM.png)

Once you've authorized the connection to Levitate with your email provider, you'll reach **Step 4: set up your signature and/or continue to the Dashboard to get started.**

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f27000ece9afe68bb7fae0/file-ycZyGAmos0.png)

## Connecting Your Email

Levitate sends messages from your email address by connecting to your email server. You'll enter your email address and email password during initial setup (Step 3 above), and again later if the connection drops — for example, after a password change or a provider security update.

To connect or reconnect at any time, go to [https://secure.levitate.ai/#/user/connect-email](https://secure.levitate.ai/#/user/connect-email). Levitate supports Google, Office 365, Exchange, and IMAP/SMTP — follow the section below that matches your provider.

### Email Connection Requirements

Levitate uses the email connection to send messages, including email campaigns, from your address. If you don't plan to send email from Levitate, ask your Success Specialist whether the email connection requirement can be turned off for your user.

- **Enable IMAP and SMTP:** Some email providers let an administrator turn off IMAP and SMTP access for individual users. If you connect with IMAP/SMTP and the connection fails, make sure IMAP and SMTP are enabled for your user in your email provider's settings.
- **Use an app-specific password if your provider requires one:** See ["Invalid Credentials" during email connection](https://help.levitate.ai/article/33-connect-your-email-to-levitate#invalid-credentials-email-connection) below.
- **Connect a real mailbox:** A distribution list address can't be connected to Levitate. An alias can't be your primary email connection, but you can connect it as a shared or alias mailbox and send campaigns from it — see [Shared Mailbox Connections for Office 365 and Google](https://help.levitate.ai/article/409-shared-mailbox-connections-for-office-365-and-google).

### IMAP or SMTP

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f270001b49134fe879589c/file-ojzKjqyjgr.png)

### Office 365

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f26fffece9afe68bb7fade/file-KwcmjVA5HY.png)

### Google

![](https://d33v4339jhl8k0.cloudfront.net/docs/assets/602c2dafc6b4255ec1783588/images/69f26ffe1b49134fe879589a/file-BtYPWlAXMS.png)

**Note:** Google Workspace (business email on your own domain, such as name@yourcompany.com) and personal Gmail (@gmail.com) are set up as separate providers on your Levitate account. If your address uses a custom domain hosted by Google, the connect button should read "Connect Google Workspace with Levitate." If it shows a different provider, or the connection fails to verify, contact your Success Specialist or [Support team](mailto:support@levitateapp.com?subject=Google%20Workspace%20connection%20help) so they can confirm the provider configured for your account.

### Hotmail

Accounts using Hotmail log in to Levitate using Outlook settings. If you're unable to connect, reach out to your Success Specialist or our [Support team](mailto:support@levitateapp.com?subject=Hotmail%20connection%20help).

### iCloud

To connect an iCloud Mail account, you'll need to create an app-specific password — Apple requires this for third-party apps because Apple IDs use two-factor authentication. Go to [appleid.apple.com](http://appleid.apple.com/), generate an app password for Levitate, and use that as the email-connection password.

### Smarshmail or Intermedia

[Read our full article on connecting Smarshmail and Intermedia.](https://help.levitate.ai/article/415-connecting-to-smarshmail-and-intermedia)

### Roadrunner

Roadrunner users need their email address and email password, plus the IMAP and SMTP server settings below. Your Levitate Implementation Specialist or Success Specialist can configure these for you:

```
imap.biz.rr.com
smtp.biz.rr.com
```

### Single Sign-On (SSO)

Microsoft Office and Google Workspace users can log in to Levitate via single sign-on. To enable SSO, reach out to your Success Specialist or our [Support team](mailto:support@levitateapp.com?subject=Enable%20SSO). Once enabled, a new login button appears for connecting through Office or Google. SSO is account-wide and can't be enabled per user.

**Note:** A Google or Microsoft sign-in attempt must be completed within about 10 minutes of clicking the sign-in button. If more time passes, the sign-in is refused with an error — clicking the sign-in button again and completing it right away works.

If a Google or Microsoft sign-in is refused because of the email address you typed on the login page, you return to the login page. The reason appears in red text under the email field, and the address you typed is filled back in. Editing the address clears the message. The four messages you may see are:

- **"The account you signed in with doesn't match the address you entered."** The Google or Microsoft account you signed in with is not the one that goes with the address on the login page.
- **"We couldn't find an active user for that address."** No active Levitate user has that address.
- **"That address belongs to more than one active user. Contact support."** More than one active user has that address, so Levitate can't tell which one to sign you in as. [Contact the Support team](mailto:support@levitateapp.com?subject=SSO%20sign-in%20help) for help.
- **"This account doesn't allow signing in with that provider."** The account can't be signed in to with the Google or Microsoft option you chose.

Other single sign-on errors still appear on a separate Authentication Error page. Messages about the login page's own fields also appear under the field. For example, selecting **Next** with the email field empty shows "Please enter your email address".

## User Login Troubleshooting

### Common Login Issues

Find your symptom and jump to the troubleshooting steps:

- Can't remember your password? → [Resetting Your Password](https://help.levitate.ai/article/33-connect-your-email-to-levitate#Resetting-Your-Password-aNR-t)
- Password reset link not working or expired? → [Resetting Your Password](https://help.levitate.ai/article/33-connect-your-email-to-levitate#Resetting-Your-Password-aNR-t)
- Never logged in before / invitation link expired? → [New User First Login](https://help.levitate.ai/article/33-connect-your-email-to-levitate#New-User-First-Login-H54am)
- Getting "invalid credentials" with the correct password? → ["Invalid Credentials" Errors](https://help.levitate.ai/article/33-connect-your-email-to-levitate#Invalid-Credentials-Errors-ATZYg)
- Account shows "not found" or email not recognized? → [Account Not Found Errors](https://help.levitate.ai/article/33-connect-your-email-to-levitate#Account-Not-Found-Errors-trPxm)
- Browser or cache preventing login? → [Browser and Technical Issues](https://help.levitate.ai/article/33-connect-your-email-to-levitate#Browser-and-Technical-Issues-eXdbi)
- Two-factor authentication issues? → [Contact Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com)

### Resetting Your Password

1. Go to the [Levitate login page](https://secure.levitate.ai/#/login)
2. Click the "Forgot Password?" link
3. Enter your email address (must match account email)
4. Check your inbox for the password reset email
   - Subject line: "Levitate - Password Reset Request."
   - From: [mailer@appmail.levitate.ai](mailto:mailer@appmail.levitate.ai)
5. Click the reset link in the email (link expires after 24 hours)
6. Create a new password meeting requirements:
   - Minimum 8 characters
   - Include at least 1 uppercase letter
   - Include at least 1 lowercase letter
   - Include at least 1 number
7. Log in with the new password

#### If the password reset email doesn't arrive

- Check spam/junk folder
- Verify email address spelling
- Try alternate email addresses on your account
- Whitelist @appmail.levitate.ai domain in email settings
- Wait 5 minutes and try again (rate limiting)
- [Contact Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) if the email still doesn't arrive

#### If your new password is rejected

The Reset Password page lists four requirements: at least 8 characters, one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number. A password can meet all four and still be rejected when you submit it. Passwords you've used before, and common or easily guessed ones, are rejected even if the checklist is satisfied.

When a password is rejected, an error appears above the **Reset Password** button. It shows the message returned by the sign-in system followed by this hint: "Also rejected: passwords you've used before, and common or easily guessed ones." The password and confirm-password fields keep what you typed, and the error clears as soon as you start typing again. Choose a different password and select **Reset Password** again.

To see these rules before you submit, hover over or tab to the information (i) icon next to the **New Password** label. Its tooltip shows the same "Also rejected" sentence. The same icon appears next to **Password** when you create your password during new-user account setup.

Other problems show a different message:

- **"Your password reset request is expired."** The reset link has expired, is invalid, or was already used.
- **"Something went wrong. Please try again."** The request couldn't be completed. Try submitting again.

### New User First Login

#### For users invited by an Account Admin

1. Check email for invitation from Levitate
2. Click "Set Up Account" or "Accept Invitation" link
3. Create a password for your account
4. Complete profile setup
5. Connect email (if required)

### "Invalid Credentials" Errors

1. Verify email address (check for typos, spaces)
2. Verify password (case-sensitive)
3. Try copying and pasting credentials (avoid typing errors)
4. Reset password using "Forgot Password?" link
5. Clear browser cache and cookies
6. Try a different browser or incognito/private mode
7. Disable browser password manager temporarily
8. Check if Caps Lock is on

### Account Not Found Errors

#### Common causes

- Using the wrong email address (personal vs. work email)
- Account created under a different email
- Account not yet created (ask admin to invite you)
- Typing error in email address

#### How to verify

1. Check which email received Levitate communications
2. Try all email addresses you use for work
3. Contact your account admin to verify your account email
4. Have an Admin check Settings > Admin > User Management for your name

### Browser and Technical Issues

#### Clear browser cache and cookies

Use your browser's settings to clear stored data for Levitate, then reload the login page.

#### Try a different browser

- Levitate supports: Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge
- Avoid Internet Explorer (not supported)

#### Check your internet connection

- Verify you can access other websites
- Disable VPN temporarily to test
- Try different network (mobile hotspot, guest wifi)

### When to Contact Support

#### Contact your account admin first

- You're a new user who never received invitation
- Your account access was removed
- You need your email address on the account changed
- You're unsure if you have an account

#### Contact Levitate Support

- Password reset emails not arriving after trying troubleshooting steps
- Technical errors preventing login (error codes, page not loading)
- Account locked or suspended
- Urgent access needed during business hours

## Email Connection Troubleshooting

### When Email Won't Reconnect

If your email shows as disconnected and you're unable to reconnect it, follow these steps:

#### Step 1: Clear Browser Cache and Cookies

- Clear your browser's cache and cookies
- Close and reopen your browser completely
- Log back into Levitate
- Try reconnecting your email

#### Step 2: Check Email Provider Status

- Verify your email account is accessible by logging into your email provider directly
- Ensure your password hasn't changed or expired
- Check if your email provider is experiencing outages

#### Step 3: Review Permission Settings

For Office 365/Outlook:

- Go to [myaccount.microsoft.com](https://myaccount.microsoft.com/)
- Navigate to Privacy > Apps and services
- Look for Levitate and verify that permissions are granted
- If permissions are missing or revoked, remove Levitate and reconnect

For Google:

- Go to [myaccount.google.com/permissions](https://myaccount.google.com/permissions)
- Look for Levitate under "Third-party apps with account access."
- Verify all required permissions are granted
- If permissions are missing, remove access and reconnect

#### Step 4: Try Incognito/Private Mode

- Open an incognito or private browsing window
- Log in to Levitate
- Attempt to reconnect your email
- This helps identify if browser extensions are interfering

#### Step 5: Disconnect Completely Before Reconnecting

- In Levitate, go to Settings > Email Connection
- Click "Disconnect Email" if the option is available
- Wait 60 seconds
- Click "Connect Email" and follow the authentication flow

### Common Error Messages

#### Unable to Authenticate Server

- This typically means your password has changed or permissions were revoked
- Follow Step 3 above to review permissions

#### Connection Timeout

- This may indicate a firewall or network issue
- Try connecting from a different network or contact your IT department

#### "Invalid Credentials" during email connection

- Verify your email password is correct
- Check if two-factor authentication is enabled and properly configured
- For IMAP or Exchange connections, you may need an app-specific password

For the same error when logging into Levitate itself, see ["Invalid Credentials" Errors](https://help.levitate.ai/article/33-connect-your-email-to-levitate#Invalid-Credentials-Errors-ATZYg) above.

### Still having issues?

#### If you've tried all the steps above and still can't reconnect

1. Note the exact error message you're seeing
2. Take a screenshot of the error
3. Contact Levitate support with these details

## FAQs

**Q: I've tried every troubleshooting step and still can't log in — what else could be wrong?**

A: If you've reset your password, verified your email address, cleared your browser cache, and tried a different browser but still cannot log in, your account may have a billing or subscription hold. Contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) and let them know you've exhausted standard troubleshooting — they can check your account status and help restore access.

**Q: Why did my email disconnect in the first place?**

A: Common reasons include password changes, permission revocations, expired tokens, or email provider security updates that require re-authentication.

**Q: Will I lose any data if I disconnect and reconnect?**

A: No, your contacts, campaigns, and sent message history are preserved. You're simply re-establishing the connection between Levitate and your email provider.

**Q: How often do I need to reconnect my email?**

A: Most connections remain stable long-term. You should only need to reconnect if your password changes, permissions are revoked, or you see a disconnection notification.

**Q: Can I use Levitate while my email is disconnected?**

A: You can still access Levitate and view your contacts, but you won't be able to send emails or sync new email activity until you reconnect.

**Q: Why does email tracking seem slower when I use IMAP, and would switching to Google or Microsoft OAuth help?**

A: Yes, switching to a Google or Microsoft OAuth connection is typically faster for email tracking. IMAP connections require Levitate to periodically scan your mailbox for new messages, which means there is an inherent delay between when an email is sent or opened and when Levitate registers the activity. Google and Microsoft OAuth connections use push-based notifications, so Levitate is alerted as soon as new activity occurs rather than waiting for the next scheduled scan. If faster tracking is important to you and your mailbox supports Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, connecting via OAuth is the recommended option. Contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) for help switching your connection type.

**Q: What if my company uses single sign-on (SSO)?**

A: SSO connections may require your IT administrator to re-authorize the Levitate app. Contact your IT department if standard reconnection steps don't work.

**Q: I requested a password reset email but never received it — what should I do?**

A: First, check your spam or junk folder for a message from [mailer@appmail.levitate.ai](mailto:mailer@appmail.levitate.ai) with the subject "Levitate - Password Reset Request." If it's not there, verify that you entered the exact email address on your Levitate account — a different address will not receive the email. You can also add @appmail.levitate.ai to your email allowlist and try the request again (wait a few minutes between attempts). If the email still does not arrive after trying these steps, contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) — they can send a reset link directly.

**Q: I completed the password reset but I still cannot log in — what should I check?**

A: After resetting, make sure you are typing the new password exactly as you created it (passwords are case-sensitive). Clear your browser cache and cookies, or try an incognito/private window, to rule out a cached session interfering. If a password manager auto-filled an old password, clear the saved credential and type the new one manually. If you still cannot log in, try a different supported browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge). Should none of these steps resolve the issue, contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) — they can verify your account status and help restore access.

**Q: When connecting a Microsoft 365 account to Levitate, which email account should I use to complete the connection?**

A: Complete the Microsoft 365 connection flow while signed in to the email account you want Levitate to send from — typically your primary Levitate email address. If your Microsoft 365 environment includes multiple addresses or a shared mailbox, using the correct sign-in account ensures Levitate connects to the right mailbox. If you are unsure which account to use, or if you are working with a shared or delegated mailbox, contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) for guidance.

**Q: How do I connect a Yahoo email account to Levitate, and what do I do if I get a connection error?**

A: Yahoo requires an app-specific password for third-party applications like Levitate because Yahoo accounts use two-step verification. To generate one, sign in to your Yahoo account, go to Account Security settings, and select "Generate app password." Choose "Other app," name it "Levitate," and use the generated password — not your regular Yahoo password — when connecting your email in Levitate. Note that two-step verification must be enabled on your Yahoo account for app passwords to work. If you continue to see connection errors after entering the app password, try disconnecting and reconnecting your email in Levitate. If the issue persists, contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com).

**Q: What happens to an email campaign that was in progress when my connected email account disconnects?**

A: When your email account disconnects during an active campaign send, Levitate pauses sending and notifies you by email to reconnect. Once you reconnect your email, sending can resume for any recipients who have not yet received the message. If the email remains disconnected for an extended period, the remaining sends may be cancelled. In that case, contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) to review the campaign status and determine whether a resend is needed.

**Q: I accidentally logged in or connected Levitate with the wrong email address — how do I fix this?**

A: This depends on which email address was wrong. If your Levitate account itself is set up under the wrong login email (for example, your Welcome email was sent to the wrong address), that requires a backend update — contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) and let them know which email address should be associated with your account. If instead you just connected the wrong mailbox for sending, you can fix this yourself: go to Settings > Profile and update the "Sending As" email to the correct address, then reconnect.

**Q: My browser keeps auto-filling a Gmail address at the Levitate login screen, but my account uses a different email — what should I do?**

A: Browser-saved credentials can automatically populate the wrong email address on the login page. To work around this, open an incognito or private browsing window (which ignores saved passwords) and log in from there. You can also clear the saved credential for Levitate's login page in your browser's password manager settings. If the login page is still directing you to authenticate via the wrong provider after clearing autofill data, contact your Success Specialist — the email provider configuration on your account may need to be updated.

**Q: A new user in our organization is being prompted to connect via Gmail, but our org uses Office 365 — why does this happen and how do we fix it?**

A: When a new user first logs in to Levitate, the email provider shown during setup is determined by the provider configuration on your account. If the wrong provider is displayed, contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) — they can update the email provider configuration for that user so the correct Office 365 connection is offered. This is not something individual users can change on their own.

**Q: Why did auto-discover identify my custom-domain email as Office 365 when I don't have a Microsoft 365 account?**

A: Auto-discover works by looking up the MX (Mail Exchange) DNS records for your email domain. If your domain's MX records route mail through Microsoft's infrastructure — which happens with some web hosting providers that rely on Microsoft for email delivery — Levitate will identify the address as Office 365 even though you do not manage it through a Microsoft 365 subscription. If this happens, bypass auto-discover and connect manually using IMAP/SMTP instead: go to [https://secure.levitate.ai/#/user/connect-email](https://secure.levitate.ai/#/user/connect-email), choose the IMAP/SMTP option, and enter your email address, password, and the server settings provided by your email hosting provider. If you are unsure of your IMAP or SMTP settings, check your hosting provider's documentation or contact your Success Specialist for help.

**Q: I'm unable to set up my Google Workspace email in Levitate — what should I check?**

A: First, make sure you complete the Google sign-in with the exact Google Workspace account you want Levitate to send from, and that you are using the connect page at [https://secure.levitate.ai/#/user/connect-email](https://secure.levitate.ai/#/user/connect-email). Then work through the steps in Email Connection Troubleshooting above, including reviewing Levitate's access at [myaccount.google.com/permissions](https://myaccount.google.com/permissions). If the connect button names a provider other than Google Workspace, or the connection still won't verify, contact your Success Specialist or [Levitate Support](mailto:support@levitateapp.com) — the email provider configured on your account may need to be updated, which only Levitate can change.

**Q: Does my email need to be "traditionally hosted" (such as @gmail.com or @outlook.com) to connect to Levitate?**

A: No. Custom-domain business email works as long as it is hosted by a supported provider. An address on your own domain that is hosted by Google is connected using the Google Workspace option rather than the Gmail option, and one hosted by Microsoft uses Office 365. Levitate also supports Exchange and IMAP/SMTP for other hosting setups. If you are not sure who hosts your email, ask your IT department or domain provider, or contact your Success Specialist.
